call_purpose: You reached out to sell your product with monthly and yearly plans on the same checkout page, to send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and to find out how to add GST to your prices.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed your checkout page now shows both the monthly and yearly options.

Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option in your product's Pages settings and saved it, and after a test purchase you confirmed it took you straight to your thank-you page.

covered.text: We explained that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer.
customer_next_steps.timeline: that week (the week of our call)

support_next_steps.text: We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
